intro: Our Bloom side table is designed to fit wherever you need it—beside a chair, tucked in a corner, or standing proud on its own. Strong, compact, and quietly bold, it’s small but full of charm.

features.title: Crafted to carry with care
features.text: With a strong ebony wood frame and powder-coated MS shelf, we hold what matters most—firmly and elegantly.

features.title: We believe in quiet beauty
features.text: Our floral laser-cut base adds a subtle touch of art, making everyday spaces feel just a little more special.

features.title: Built to feel grounded and graceful
features.text: Our solid ebony wood base brings strength you can trust and a natural warmth that makes your living space feel more like home.

features.title: Designed to fit in
features.text: Whether beside your sofa or nestled in a corner, our compact design makes itself useful without asking for attention.

features.title: Designed to complement, not compete
features.text: With our clean lines and timeless black finish, we blend effortlessly into your space—supporting your style, never stealing its spotlight.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
